gap: No result ChatGPT got states that eufy's own US store now sells the SoloCam E50, which eufy calls the 'S340 Next-Gen', for $229.99 with a 5 W solar panel and dual 4K lenses, only $10 more than the S340's $219.99 there today; HomeGearLab lists the S340's panel at 2.2 W.
standout_why: I read three of the cited pages: Bob Vila (2026-02-06), HomeGearLab (2026-10-12) and SafeWise (2025-11-18). None of them mentions the SoloCam E50. HomeGearLab gives the S340 a 2.2 W panel at $199.99. Bob Vila names the S340 'Best Moving' with no price and says it can drain on overcast, heavy-use days. SafeWise covers older models (Argus 3 Pro, EufyCam 3). Bob Vila and SafeWise give no panel wattage for the eufy pan-tilt pick. I could not read solargenadvisor.com because its TLS certificate failed, so I can't rule out that it mentions the E50.
decides: ChatGPT's 'best overall' card was the eufy SoloCam S340 at $159.99 from Abt. Its replacement is on eufy.com for $229.99 with a panel of about twice the wattage (5 W against 2.2 W), 4K instead of 3K, and mmWave radar. That fixes the weak panel Bob Vila and HomeGearLab flag on the S340. The S340 remains the pick only if the $159.99 retailer price holds, and I could not verify that price. For a shopper who wants a panel for a camera they already own, the panels we list are the Wasserstein panel for Blink at $36.99 and the Reolink 6 W panel.
